primary_metrics.definition: Share of eligible low- and medium-risk tasks completed without human rework after acceptance.
primary_metrics.action_if_breached: Tighten task contracts and acceptance checks before expanding autonomy.

primary_metrics.definition: Share of tasks that required CEO or human reviewer intervention beyond the planned accepting role.
primary_metrics.action_if_breached: Review routing and escalation thresholds with Governor before expanding autonomy.

primary_metrics.definition: Median hours from intake to owner+policy-ready task state.
primary_metrics.action_if_breached: Reduce queue ambiguity or policy bottlenecks before adding more parallel work.

primary_metrics.definition: Median hours from acceptance to shared-truth sync.
primary_metrics.action_if_breached: Reduce closeout scope and fix sync bottlenecks before increasing task throughput.

primary_metrics.definition: Share of completed tasks that needed rollback, re-open, or material rework.
primary_metrics.action_if_breached: Governor reviews whether policy, acceptance checks, or rollout notes are too weak.

secondary_metrics.definition: Estimated founder hours freed by AI-handled work compared with the previous manual loop.
Share of total active tasks where the specialist owner is an AI role rather than a human.
Share of active tasks that have at least one telemetry event in the review window.
secondary_metrics.action_if_breached: Backfill missing telemetry or lower autonomy until coverage is reliable.

secondary_metrics.definition: Share of completed tasks with at least one lightweight review or eval signal in telemetry metadata.
secondary_metrics.action_if_breached: Add lightweight acceptance or eval checks before repeating the same workflow more autonomously.
